validation: equal mean clean, refresh_train, block_train, combined_train
selection: per arm and seed: minimum V loss, earliest step, recipe id; seal all six winners before E
problem_gate: gate split F0 mean degradation >=2% and at least two corruptions >=1%; no E
pass: each seed gain vs strongest simple baseline >0; two-seed mean gain >=1% F0; clean degradation vs strongest clean baseline <=0.5% F0 on each seed
evaluation: equal mean of four declared unseen corruption variants; clean reported separately
stop: one fixed revision; no LR or threshold expansion; no new source without subsequent review
